title: Any Man of Mine
lyrics_plain:
Copyright (P) Trycho 1984-1996Copyright (P) Trycho 1984-1996
Any man of mine
better be proud of me
Even when I'm ugly
he still better love me
And I can be late
for a date that's fine
But he better be on time
Any man of mine
will say it fits just right
When last year's dress
is just a little too tight
And anything I do or say
better be okay
When I have a bad hair day
If I change my mind
A million times
I wanna hear him say
Yeah, yeah, yeah I like it that way
Any man of mine better walk the line
Better show me a teasin' squeezin'
pleasin' kinda time
I need a man who knows,
how the story goes
Gotta be a heartbeatin' fine treatin'
Breathtakin' earthquakin' kind
Any man of mine
Any man of mine better disagree
When I say a woman's lookin' better than me
Cook him dinner, I burn it black
better say, mmmm, like it like that
If I change my mind
A million times
I wanna hear him say
Yeah, yeah, yeah I like it that way
Any man of mine better walk the line
Better show me a teasin' squeezin'
pleasin' kinda time
I need a man who knows,
how the story goes
Gotta be a heartbeatin' fine treatin'
Breathtakin' earthquakin' kind
Any man of mine
Let me hear ya say Yeah,
yeah, yeah I like it that way
Any man of mine better walk the line
Better show me a teasin' squeezin'
pleasin' kinda time
I need a man who knows,
how the story goes
Gotta be a heartbeatin' fine treatin'
Breathtakin' earthquakin' kind
Any man of mine
